actions.addCustomerMatchData.description: Upload e-mails, phones or addresses to a Customer Match audience list (Data Manager API)
actions.addCustomerMatchData.props.accep: Google requires every upload to confirm that the advertiser accepted the Customer Match terms of service (https://support.google.com/adspolicy/answer/6299717). Tick to confirm.
actions.addCustomerMatchData.props.adPer: Consent the members gave for personalized advertising. Pick the value that matches what the members actually agreed to.
actions.addCustomerMatchData.props.adUse: Consent the members gave for their data to be used for advertising (required by Google for uploads, enforced in the EEA). Pick the value that matches what the members actually agreed to.
actions.addCustomerMatchData.props.custo: Google Ads account to operate on. Accounts reached through a manager need the manager ID in the connection.
actions.addCustomerMatchData.props.membe: One entry per person. Fill any of: e-mail, phone (E.164, e.g. +5511999999999), or the full address set (first name, last name, country code, postal code). E-mail, phone, first name and last name are normalized and SHA-256 hashed before upload; country code and postal code are sent unhashed (trimmed, country code uppercased), as Google requires.
actions.addCustomerMatchData.props.userL: CRM-based audience list (Customer Match) the members go to.
actions.addCustomerMatchData.props.waitF: Poll the request status for up to ~2 minutes. Matching usually takes longer, so this is off by default: the output carries the request ids to check later.
actions.createRecord.description: Create a campaign, ad group, ad, keyword or audience list
actions.createRecord.props.customerId.de: Google Ads account to operate on. Accounts reached through a manager need the manager ID in the connection.
actions.createRecord.props.record.descri:
Fields of the new record as the Google Ads REST API expects them (camelCase, enums as strings, money in micros as strings). Minimal examples:

**Campaign**: `{"name":"Spring sale","status":"PAUSED","advertisingChannelType":"SEARCH","campaignBudget":"customers/1234567890/campaignBudgets/1122334455","manualCpc":{},"networkSettings":{"targetGoogleSearch":true,"targetSearchNetwork":true},"containsEuPoliticalAdvertising":"DOES_NOT_CONTAIN_EU_POLITICAL_ADVERTISING"}`

**Ad group**: `{"name":"Running shoes","status":"ENABLED","type":"SEARCH_STANDARD","campaign":"customers/1234567890/campaigns/123456789","cpcBidMicros":"1000000"}`

**Ad**: `{"adGroup":"customers/1234567890/adGroups/987654321","status":"PAUSED","ad":{"finalUrls":["https://www.example.com/shoes"],"responsiveSearchAd":{"headlines":[{"text":"Running shoes"},{"text":"Free shipping"},{"text":"Shop today"}],"descriptions":[{"text":"Lightweight shoes for every runner."},{"text":"Order now and run tomorrow."}]}}}`

**Keyword**: `{"adGroup":"customers/1234567890/adGroups/987654321","status":"ENABLED","keyword":{"text":"running shoes","matchType":"PHRASE"}}`

**Audience list**: `{"name":"Newsletter subscribers","description":"Customers who opted in to the newsletter","membershipLifeSpan":"30","crmBasedUserList":{"uploadKeyType":"CONTACT_INFO"}}`

A campaign needs an existing campaign budget (`campaignBudgets:mutate` via Custom API Call).
Which kind of record: campaign, ad group, ad, keyword or audience list.
Ask Google to validate the request without applying it. Nothing is created, changed or removed.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Call any Google Ads API endpoint. The path must start with the API version: /v25/customers/{customerId}/... (e.g. /v25/customers/1234567890/campaignBudgets:mutate). Data Manager API endpoints take a full URL on https://datamanager.googleapis.com (e.g. GET https://datamanager.googleapis.com/v1/requestStatus:retrieve?requestId=... to check a Customer Match upload).
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.deleteRecord.description: Remove a campaign, ad group, ad, keyword or audience list (Google marks it REMOVED; it cannot be restored)
actions.deleteRecord.props.customerId.de: Google Ads account to operate on. Accounts reached through a manager need the manager ID in the connection.
actions.deleteRecord.props.identifier.de: Numeric id for campaigns, ad groups and audience lists; `<adGroupId>~<adId>` for ads; `<adGroupId>~<criterionId>` for keywords. A full resource name (`customers/…/campaigns/…`) also works.
Which kind of record: campaign, ad group, ad, keyword or audience list.
Ask Google to validate the request without applying it. Nothing is created, changed or removed.
actions.removeCustomerMatchData.descript: Remove members (by e-mail, phone or address) from a Customer Match audience list (Data Manager API)
actions.removeCustomerMatchData.props.cu: Google Ads account to operate on. Accounts reached through a manager need the manager ID in the connection.
actions.removeCustomerMatchData.props.me: One entry per person. Fill any of: e-mail, phone (E.164, e.g. +5511999999999), or the full address set (first name, last name, country code, postal code). E-mail, phone, first name and last name are normalized and SHA-256 hashed before upload; country code and postal code are sent unhashed (trimmed, country code uppercased), as Google requires.
actions.removeCustomerMatchData.props.us: CRM-based audience list (Customer Match) the members go to.
actions.removeCustomerMatchData.props.wa: Poll the request status for up to ~2 minutes. Matching usually takes longer, so this is off by default: the output carries the request ids to check later.
actions.retrieveReport.description: Performance metrics per campaign, ad group, ad, keyword, search term or account, over a date range
Google Ads account to operate on. Accounts reached through a manager need the manager ID in the connection.
actions.retrieveReport.props.endDate.des: YYYY-MM-DD, with the custom date range.
actions.retrieveReport.props.fields.desc: GAQL attribute fields to return next to the metrics (default: the id, name and status of the chosen level).
actions.retrieveReport.props.maxRows.des: Stops after this many rows (default 1000, at most 100000).
actions.retrieveReport.props.metrics.des: GAQL metric fields. Default: metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, metrics.ctr, metrics.average_cpc, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.conversions, metrics.conversions_value.
actions.retrieveReport.props.orderBy.des: e.g. `metrics.clicks DESC`. The field must be selected.
actions.retrieveReport.props.query.descr: When filled, runs this query as-is and ignores every field above except Customer and Max Rows.
actions.retrieveReport.props.resource.de: The level the metrics are broken down by.
actions.retrieveReport.props.segmentByDa: Adds `segments.date`, so each entity returns one row per day instead of a total.
actions.retrieveReport.props.startDate.d: YYYY-MM-DD, with the custom date range.
actions.searchRecords.description: Run a GAQL query (campaigns, ad groups, ads, keywords, audiences, reports) with pagination
actions.searchRecords.props.customerId.d: Google Ads account to operate on. Accounts reached through a manager need the manager ID in the connection.
actions.searchRecords.props.fetchAllPage: Follow the pagination until the query is exhausted (up to Max Rows). Off: return one page and its next page token.
actions.searchRecords.props.maxRows.desc: Only with "Fetch All Pages". Stops after this many rows (default 1000, at most 100000).
actions.searchRecords.props.pageToken.de: Only without "Fetch All Pages": the `nextPageToken` of a previous run to continue from.
actions.searchRecords.props.query.descri: Google Ads Query Language SELECT statement. Examples: `SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, campaign.status FROM campaign ORDER BY campaign.id` · `SELECT ad_group_criterion.criterion_id, ad_group_criterion.keyword.text FROM ad_group_criterion WHERE ad_group_criterion.type = KEYWORD` · `SELECT user_list.id, user_list.name FROM user_list`. Use `LIMIT` to cap the total.
actions.updateRecord.description: Change fields of an existing campaign, ad group, ad, keyword or audience list
actions.updateRecord.props.customerId.de: Google Ads account to operate on. Accounts reached through a manager need the manager ID in the connection.
actions.updateRecord.props.identifier.de: Numeric id for campaigns, ad groups and audience lists; `<adGroupId>~<adId>` for ads; `<adGroupId>~<criterionId>` for keywords. A full resource name (`customers/…/campaigns/…`) also works.
actions.updateRecord.props.record.descri: Only the fields to change, as the Google Ads REST API names them (camelCase), e.g. `{"status":"PAUSED"}` or `{"name":"New name","cpcBidMicros":"1500000"}`. The update mask is derived from these keys; fields you leave out are untouched. Ads are immutable except for `status`: to change an ad, create a new one.
Which kind of record: campaign, ad group, ad, keyword or audience list.
Ask Google to validate the request without applying it. Nothing is created, changed or removed.
auth.description:
Connect with an OAuth client from **your own** Google Cloud project:

1. In [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/), select or create a project. **APIs & Services → Library**: enable **Google Ads API** and **Data Manager API** (the latter only for Customer Match uploads).
2. Open the **Google Ads API** page in the console and check the project's **access level**. New projects get *Test* access (test accounts only). To operate real accounts, apply for *Explorer* or *Basic* access there (Google reviews it, typically within 10 business days).
3. **APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen**: add the scopes `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/adwords` and `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/datamanager`. While the app is in *Testing*, add the Google accounts that will connect as test users.
4. **APIs & Services → Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID**, type *Web application*. Add the **Redirect URL shown below** to *Authorized redirect URIs*.
5. Paste the **Client ID** and **Client Secret** here and sign in with a Google account that can access the Google Ads accounts you want to automate.

**Login Customer ID (Manager Account)**: fill it only when you reach the accounts through a **manager (MCC) account**: the manager's 10-digit ID. Leave it empty when you connect directly as the advertiser.
auth.props.loginCustomerId.description: Only when you access client accounts through a manager (MCC) account: the manager's 10-digit customer ID, with or without dashes. Leave empty when connecting directly as the advertiser.
description: Manage campaigns, ad groups, ads, keywords, audiences and performance reports in Google Ads.

triggers.newRecord.props.resourceType.de: Which kind of record: campaign, ad group, ad, keyword or audience list.
